sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent stage-A grid together with the exact cells and colors restored from transpose partners.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Repair each erased cell whose transposed coordinate is visible, producing a transpose-completed intermediate grid.
sequential_dependency.step_b: For every zero that remains, inspect its fixed-prefix suffix-mirror coordinates in the stage-A grid and copy the first visible donor.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Some suffix-mirror donors are themselves erased in the input and exist only because A restored them. Reading B from the original grid leaves those targets zero.

parametric_work.summary: Two settings (`closure`, `transpose_only`) support 2–6 demonstrations and 1–4 queries; the canonical default reproduces all supplied labels, two demonstrations eliminate the retained finite rivals, and four distinct queries include a dense 30x30 case.

target.summary: Authored the missing general Racket rule and complete native two-stage symmetry-completion family, with matched settings, generated curriculum, public projection, finite rivals, standalone audit tooling, and source-bound causal evidence.
